Connor Storrie Reportedly in Talks to Antagonize Ryan Gosling in Marvel's Ghost Rider

28 Oct 2026, 04:12 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

Image: www.ign.com · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. Casting Developments
  2. Production Outlook

Casting Developments

Actor Connor Storrie, recognized for his recent role in *Heated Rivalry* and a brief but pivotal turn in *Joker: Folie à Deux*, is reportedly in negotiations to join the Marvel Cinematic Universe. According to *The Hollywood Reporter*, Storrie is being considered for the primary villain role in the upcoming *Ghost Rider* film, where he would face off against Ryan Gosling as Johnny Blaze.

Production Outlook

Directed by Shawn Levy, the project is scheduled to begin filming next year with a projected theatrical release in July 2028. Cinematographer Linus Sandgren has been confirmed to shoot the production on film. As the project enters early development, specific character details remain unconfirmed. Readers can track verified updates and further developments regarding the Marvel slate via the official IGN report: https://www.ign.com/articles/heated-rivalry-star-connor-storrie-in-talks-to-play-villain-in-mcus-ghost-rider-movie
